description: This file defines the interface and register addresses for the ARM Generic Interrupt Controller (GIC) driver in the Zephyr RTOS. It includes register offsets, macros, and function prototypes for managing interrupts on ARM cores.

methods.name: arm_gic_irq_enable
methods.description: Enables a specific interrupt by its ID.

methods.name: arm_gic_irq_disable
methods.description: Disables a specific interrupt by its ID.

methods.name: arm_gic_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific interrupt is enabled.

methods.name: arm_gic_irq_is_pending
methods.description: Checks if a specific interrupt is pending.

methods.name: arm_gic_irq_clear_pending
methods.description: Clears the pending status of a specific interrupt.

methods.name: arm_gic_irq_set_priority
methods.description: Sets the priority and flags for a specific interrupt.

methods.name: arm_gic_get_active
methods.description: Returns the ID of the currently active interrupt.

methods.name: arm_gic_eoi
methods.description: Signals end-of-interrupt for a given interrupt ID.

methods.name: gic_raise_sgi
methods.description: Raises a Software Generated Interrupt (SGI) to target cores.
